source.title: Tales of Eternia Remastered
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Fantasy Violence, Mild Blood, Mild Language, Suggestive ThemesGamesTales of Eternia RemasteredVersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalFantasy Violence, Mild Blood, Mild Language, Suggestive ThemesLoadingFrom opposite skies, voices unite.Experience Tales of Eternia, remastered for the first time ever.• An Epic Journey with Two Worlds at StakeJourney to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.Harnessing the power of elemental spirits known as the Greater Craymels, Reid and his companions embark on an epic journey to save the two realms from catastrophe.• Exhilarating Battle Action with Speed and FreedomFeaturing the Aggressive Linear Motion Battle System (A-LMBS), which enables diverse Arte usage, continued combos, and coordination with each unique party member.Experience thrilling combat as you outmaneuver enemies and defeat them one after another with fast-paced, dynamic 2D battle action.• The Same Moving Experience, Now Easier to PlayGameplay is better than ever with the quality-of-life features that have been added, including destination markers, the ability to disable enemy encounters, and high-speed mode during auto-battle.Additionally, graphics and SFX can be toggled between modes, allowing you to experience the nostalgic atmosphere of the original game.Software description provided by the publisher.Related tagsRole playingChoose your difficultyPixel artRaise your statsVoiced charactersShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)7 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. Movie Strategy Guidebook My Nintendo Career Sitemap Home News 2026October Facebook Twitter Upcoming Games – October 2026 30/09/2026 This October, return to Wuhu Island, answer the call of duty, let your heart be your guiding key, and more! Check out this selection of games launching soon, and don’t forget to click on any that catch your eye for pre-orders, purchases or to add them to your Wish List. KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I～III] – October 8th Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Subscribe to onYouTube The worlds of Disney and FINAL FANTASY combine in three unforgettable collections! Enjoy heartfelt stories and stylish action battles in a grand saga of light and darkness. This bundle includes every one of Sora’s adventures to date – each collection is also available to purchase separately. Owners of the KINGDOM HEARTS Cloud titles can purchase the native Nintendo Switch 2 versions at a discount, then transfer their saved progress. Try KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC) for free > Order of the Sinking Star – October 8th Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Discover a massive puzzle adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1,000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery. Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen – October 9th Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Subscribe to onYouTube Set out for adventure with your loyal Pawns in this expanded version of the cult fantasy RPG! Explore a snow-covered new region, encounter unfamiliar enemies, and express yourself with all-new character customisation options. Ratatan – October 14th Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 A rhythm roguelike action game, Ratatan sees intense but colourful side-scrolling battles unfold with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee. Defeat the enemies by riding the rhythm of a catchy, toe-tapping soundtrack in this delightful adventure! Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse – October 15th Coming to Nintendo Switch The legendary Castlevania series returns in a new tale blending acrobatic action with in-depth exploration. Battle to the bottom of a dark conspiracy as Rose Belmont, daughter of Trevor Belmont. With your ancestors’ holy whip in hand, freely traverse Gothic landscapes and put to rest the creatures of the night. Resident Evil 2 Deluxe Edition, Resident Evil 3 and Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition - October 16th Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Subscribe to onYouTube Three survival horror classics rise anew on Nintendo Switch 2. Live through a dual-sided nightmare in Resident Evil 2 Deluxe Edition, escape the wrath of Nemesis in Resident Evil 3, and carry out an action-packed rescue mission in Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition. Nintendo Switch Sports Resort – October 22nd Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Subscribe to onYouTube Head to the resort of Wuhu Island and play 12 different sports using intuitive motion controls! Get competitive in everything from Bowling to Thumb Wrestling, and explore the island in leisure sports like Prop Plane or Skateboarding. FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE – October 22nd Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch Experience the first ever FINAL FANTASY game to be presented in HD-2D! Travel with companions bound by fate and call upon Visions – echoes of characters from throughout the series – to aid you in turn-based battles. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 – October 23rd Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 An all-new entry in the best-selling shooter series arrives on Nintendo Switch 2. Fight across the Korean peninsula and beyond in Campaign, engage with friends and enemies around the world in Multiplayer, and make every extraction run count in DMZ. Minecraft – October 27th Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Subscribe to onYouTube Block out your calendars for an enhanced version of Minecraft – now with support for Vibrant Visuals!
